results.rationale: The brass scale, right-hand weight group and composition persist, but pedestal texture and wall/table surface details change noticeably. Several weights are added on the left rather than one, producing roughly four instead of the specified two; the beam remains level instead of tilting left. These are two clear conflicts with the supplied explanation. The left weight cluster has visibly fused/irregular shapes and an odd pale patch, although the rest of the scale is coherent.

The shortened near temple is extended into a full-length arm, though its straight thin endpoint is less convincingly finished than the curved opposite earpiece. The lens assembly shifts down and right, and tabletop texture/illumination changes beyond the repair. The glasses remain recognizable and coherent, with a small visible seam or kink at the near-arm extension.
